note: SYNTHETIC .lrc fixtures for the Web Lab Lyrics tester. LRC files are app-side lyrics artifacts — they are NOT network captures, so no live-capture provenance applies; every file is labeled synthetic in its own content and used to test the TS mirror of LrcParser.java against the LrcParserTest golden expectations.

files.name: demo_synced.lrc
files.description: Metadata tags + synced lines incl. a multi-tag line; drives the synced timeline demo.

files.name: demo_unsynced.lrc
files.description: Plain-text lyrics — parser must return synced=false.

files.name: demo_edge.lrc
files.description: Metadata tags (skipped), a timestamp-only line (skipped), and a partial-bracket line (kept as plain text).
